tweet.text:
@formigarafa @wmksidebottom Certainly not a classic, line by line, review. 

I typically don't look much at the code itself.  Sometimes I'll pop it open and do a spot check.  Most of the time I'm reviewing the output of the tools that measure code quality, coverage, and conformance to requirements.
